description.value: Large frontcountry campground at the end of a 40 km valley road on sparkling Chilliwack Lake, ringed by old-growth forest and subalpine ridges, with 40 km of trails and backcountry lake access; no cell service past the last store on the approach.

raw_osm.name: Chilliwack Lake Provincial Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active provincial campground with 182 frontcountry campsites, though OSM lists capacity as 146 — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. The website explicitly encourages reservations ('Please make reservations prior to your trip') and links to frontcountry camping reservation policies, confirming reservations are accepted. OSM tags confirm tents permitted, no internet access, and a sanitary dump station, but the website provides no detail on showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Capacity discrepancy: OSM tag lists 146 sites, but the BC Parks website states 182 frontcountry campsites.
Phone number (+1-604-986-9371) is attributed to operator Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd. and is not corroborated by the fetched BC Parks website content.
No cell service past the On the Way store on Chilliwack Lake Road — relevant logistical concern for cyclists.

OSM name ('Chilliwack Lake Provincial Campground') differs from the official park name on the website ('Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park'); OSM name refers to the specific campground within the larger park.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established BC provincial campground with confirmed tent camping, reservations, and substantial capacity; a clear fit for touring cyclists seeking an overnight stop deep in the Chilliwack River Valley.

wow_evidence: 182 frontcountry campsites at Chilliwack Lake, ringed by old-growth forest and subalpine ridges
